title_pro.en:
Upcycling Table from Industrial Scrap Metal
A contemporary upcycling table that transforms industrial scrap metal into a functional design piece. Each table is carefully selected, reimagined, and handcrafted by WPN artisans, giving new value to materials that were once considered waste.
The design features a strong steel structure, an industrial-style finish, and distinctive gold rivets — symbolizing the connection between the past and the future. More than just furniture, each piece carries its own story and has been brought back to life with a new purpose.

Color Tone: Black / Steel / Gold Rivets
